text: School uniforms reduce bullying in schools because clothing differences matter less.
School uniforms do not reduce bullying in schools, and some studies find no effect.
Uniforms save families money every year because they replace fashionable clothes.
Uniforms limit self expression, which matters for the development of students.
Research linking uniforms to higher grades is weak and often confounded by other school policies.
Uniform policies make dress codes simple to enforce and reduce morning arguments at home.
